docs.text: Add Emergency Swap Swap helps with short-term memory pressure but does not replace RAM. ls -lh /swapfile sudo fallocate -l 512M /swapfile sudo chmod 600 /swapfile sudo mkswap /swapfile sudo swapon /swapfile free -h Make it persistent (add only once): grep -n "/swapfile" /etc/fstab echo "/swapfile none swap sw 0 0" | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab Check disk space with df -h / before creating the file.

docs.text: Check Free Memory Quick overview free -h Look at the available column. It shows memory that can be used without swapping, and it matters more than the free column. Check swap swapon --show No output means no swap is active. Find which processes use the most memory ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -n 10 Detailed memory info cat /proc/meminfo | head -n 5 vmstat 1 5 Live view top # press M to sort by memory, q to quit Check disk space too Low disk space often shows up together with low memory. df -h / sudo du -xhd1 /var 2>/dev/null sudo journalctl --disk-usage Check for stuck package processes ps aux | grep -E "apt|dpkg" Do not kill package processes or delete lock files until you know what they are.
